description: Duplication of the Brunswick Heads bypass and Pacific Highway upgrade Brunswick River to Yelgun: representations report is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The Proposal relates to an 8.7km upgrading, including the duplication of the Brunswick Heads Bypass and the construction of a new dual carriageway between the Brunswick River and Yelgun. The works would commence approximately 500 metres north of Saddle Road, Brunswick Heads and rejoin the existing Highway near Stock Route Road at Yelgun. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales, brunswick heads bypass, pacific highway, road upgrade. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-12-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
